method: Spawn rows from agent.subagent_spawns with final_response md5 b4aefd29108f232f9c0d5a4b030215c1 in the window (DB: 78 rows; parquet storm census: 79). Control: first 25 spawns in the same window with status=completed, final_response matching neither storm md5, length>200. Features computed on SQL left(prompt,2500) previews; token counts measured with tiktoken cl100k_base on previews; prompt_chars is exact (SQL length()). Quarantine held: no verbatim canned bodies written; previews checked by md5 against both storm signatures.

discriminating_features_ranked.feature: is_workflow_child (prompt opens with "## Workflow Agent Output Contract")
discriminating_features_ranked.reading: Absolute separation. All refused spawns are direct subagent.spawn children; workflow agent() children (vompl/clean path) never got the canned refusal.
A quarter of refused spawns are utterly benign one-line probes ("reply with the word pong", "what is the hostname of this machine?"). Prompt content cannot be the trigger.

Correlate, not trigger. 15 of 21 refused trivial probes have lex_combined==0; 5 refused real tasks (hostname/epoch/ACK probes) have lex_combined==0; control rows with lex_combined>0 ran genuine. Vocabulary reflects the campaign (most refused tasks were refusal-hunt waves), not the classifier trigger.
NOT discriminating by itself: 6 parents appear in BOTH sets and produced both refused and genuine spawns inside the same window. Poisoned-parent alone cannot explain outcomes.
Confounded by the workflow-contract boilerplate (~5k chars) dominating the control set. Not a plausible trigger on its own.

discriminating_features_ranked.refused: 34 distinct minutes, 15 burst minutes (e.g. 9 spawns in one minute at 05:07Z)
discriminating_features_ranked.reading: Both sets are bursty (wave launches). At 2026-09-16 07:43Z both refused (6) and genuine (4) spawns occurred in the same minute: time alone does not decide.

qualitative_differential.refused_prompts: Plain task prompts with no workflow-contract header. Content spans: 21 trivial one-line probes (pong/hello/hostname/epoch/ACK), 40 refusal-investigation wave tasks (hash-spec, watchdog autofix, proto/WS deobfuscation, PID-boundary reads, storm correlation), 7 infra-ops tasks (Limine/DP-1 black screen, DefaultTrackSelector patch verify, androidx rebase, secret-gist expansion via gh api), 4 security-forensics tasks (portscan, gate diagnostics, shell-config audit), and 6 misc (patch archaeology, subagent-list nudges, spawn-router test). Benign and sensitive prompts alike were refused.
qualitative_differential.control_prompts: 20/25 are workflow agent() children: identical "## Workflow Agent Output Contract" JSON-envelope boilerplate (~5k chars, near-identical md5 across several) followed by the real lane task, all of which executed genuinely with real final_responses (206-5012 chars). The 5 plain control prompts are short benign tasks from parent 5a4f76c0 (current main agent): list a directory, read a summary file, check hook definitions, read 3 lines of a JSONL, plus one Muse product-doc grounding Q&A probe — all ran genuine.
qualitative_differential.key_absence: NOTHING in the refused prompt text predicts refusal: the same parent (ff521137) that had 19 refused spawns also had 1 genuine control; 5a4f76c0 had 1 refused vs 4 genuine. The separating surface is launch path (spawn inheritance), not prompt text.

classifier_confusion_hypothesis: The classifier is not firing on the spawn prompt at all. It fires on the child's inherited parent-chat context: direct subagent.spawn children inherit poisoned parent session history (which contains persisted verbatim storm rows and compaction checkpoints), and the canned refusal triggers on an inherited context item BEFORE the task item is ever evaluated — hence 21 trivially-benign probes (e.g. "What is the hostname of this machine?") receive the canned refusal. Workflow agent() children (vompl path) launch with clean context and never inherit the poison, so they execute genuinely even when carrying refusal-hunt vocabulary in their prompts. Parent identity alone does not discriminate (6 parents mixed), and prompt vocabulary correlates with refusal only because the campaign itself was spawning refusal-investigation tasks. In short: the classifier is confusing inherited poisoned context for the current turn's content.
caveats: Features measured on 2500-char previews; prompts longer than 2500 chars truncated in feature extraction (coverage recorded per row; median refused plen 845 < 2500, most refused rows fully covered).
DB found 78 refused rows vs parquet 79; one parquet row likely sits just outside the epoch window. No impact on conclusions.
Control = first 25 of 93 genuine spawns in window (deterministic, time-ordered); not randomized.
Prompt vocabulary lexicons are rule-based keyword lists, not the actual serving classifier; they are evidence for correlation analysis only.
